preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All input integers n, a, b are positive and ≤ 10^9.
Each test case line contains exactly three integers: n, a, b.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' if n_in_set(n, a, b) else stdout.strip() == 'No'
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'Yes' if n is in the set generated by the rules, otherwise 'No'.
